name: Jonjee Hi-Tech Industrial and Commercial Holding Co.,Ltd
summary: Jonjee Hi-Tech Industrial and Commercial Holding Co.,Ltd produces and sells seasoning products in China and internationally. The company offers soy sauce, chicken powder, oyster sauce, sauce, cooking wine, vinegar, edible oil, fermented bean curd, sauces, monosodium glutamate, and other seasoning products. It also provides property services, gardening, and housing brokerage services. In addition, the company engages in the property management, property leasing, property services, and various professional consulting services, as well as provides cleaning and greening maintenance, security, property maintenance and custody, and consulting services.
